title: Unity license secrets in GitHub Actions
summary: Owner adds the Unity activation secrets so unity-tests and ios-build stop skipping. Depends on the Unity account approved in the Foreman's M0 AUTH batch. Secret values are never pasted anywhere but the GitHub secrets UI.

acceptance_tests.test: unity-tests and ios-build preflight report 'project and license present' on the next run after M0-UNITY-01 merges.
No secret value appears in any commit, issue, PR, log, or screenshot.

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording
unblocked: Unity account approved (AUTH #008, M0 batch). Owner adds the license secrets once the Unity account exists.

Operator completed. Unity Personal activated via Unity Hub 3.21.3 for admin@prolectio.com on 2026-09-23 (Hub produced the .ulf directly; no .alf step). GitHub Actions secrets UNITY_LICENSE (raw .ulf XML), UNITY_EMAIL, UNITY_PASSWORD are set; values never in the repo, chat, or logs. The .ulf is machine-bound (Hub VM), so hosted runners rely on UNITY_EMAIL + UNITY_PASSWORD per the lockout fix. Owner to set the repository variable UNITY_CI_ENABLED=true (Owner-reserved) once the Unity account is confirmed unlocked; AT-1/AT-2 evidence is the first preflight run=true after that.

Reopened (done -> blocked). The first ios-build activation (run 36072046904, workflow_dispatch on 322f328) passed preflight but game-ci license activation failed: Unity login rejected UNITY_EMAIL/UNITY_PASSWORD with HTTP 401 (15 failed sign-ins across 6 attempts). UNITY_CI_ENABLED was removed again to stop further failed sign-ins and a repeat account lockout. Owner must fix the Unity password and re-set the secret. Close after the first successful activation (preflight run=true + activation success).

Closed (blocked -> done). The Owner reset the Unity password and re-set the UNITY_PASSWORD Actions secret (2026-09-25 18:28 CDT); UNITY_CI_ENABLED=true is set again. ios-build run 36201220032 (https://github.com/BlissDirective/Gigantic-Journeys/actions/runs/36201220032, workflow_dispatch on 80d2cef): preflight run=true ('project, switch, and Unity login present'); game-ci activated the Unity Personal license on the first try ('Activation successful', no HTTP 401s or retries) and returned the license at job end ('Successfully returned ULF license'; serial masked in the log). The closing criterion set at reopen (preflight run=true + activation success) is met. AT-1 met (login secrets present, preflight run=true). AT-3 met for this run (no secret values in the log; secret-scan green). AT-2 partly met: ios-build preflight reports the project and Unity login present, but the literal 'next run after M0-UNITY-01 merges' check cannot happen until M0-UNITY-01 lands; the unity-tests preflight is exercised by the next push to main. The same run then failed at the export step with 'Cannot build untitled scene' (exit 103) because unity/ProjectSettings has no EditorBuildSettings.asset; that is M0-UNITY-01 scope, deferred there. The run shows as cancelled because the watcher cancelled it after the export failed.
